title: Apple (AAPL) Stake Decreased by Baskin Financial Services Inc.
text:
Baskin Financial Services Inc. cut its stake in shares of Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 1.4% during the fourth quarter, according to its most recent Form 13F filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). The fund owned 163,522 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 2,357 shares during the quarter. Apple comprises approximately 5.2% of Baskin Financial Services Inc.’s investment portfolio, making the stock its biggest holding. Baskin Financial Services Inc.’s holdings in Apple were worth $27,673,000 at the end of the most recent reporting period.

Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last posted its quarterly earnings results on Thursday, February 1st. The iPhone maker reported $3.89 earnings per share for the quarter, beating the consensus estimate of $3.82 by $0.07. Apple had a net margin of 21.13% and a return on equity of 37.37%. The business had revenue of $88.29 billion during the quarter, compared to analysts’ expectations of $87.62 billion. During the same quarter in the prior year, the company posted $3.36 EPS. The business’s revenue for the quarter was up 12.7% on a year-over-year basis. equities analysts forecast that Apple will post 11.3 earnings per share for the current fiscal year.
